answer: Agents bond stake to a polynomial identity commitment and evaluate it for each epoch; Semaphore proofs bind messages to one hidden identity while RLN nullifiers enforce a per-epoch rate limit. Reusing a nullifier yields distinct Shamir shares, enabling recovery of the private key and immediate collateral slashing. The saffron validator checks proofs, the gale carries evidence across nodes, and a trellis of epoch commitments makes penalties auditable.
